briefing: Market was neutral today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.1%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so per strategy guidance we're holding all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines rather than fully invested. With only $189 in cash today — below the $500 threshold needed to comfortably size a new position — the disciplined move is to hold that cash and wait for a stronger setup rather than forcing a small, low-conviction buy.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指未投資、留作後備的現金。今日現金僅約189美元，未達到500美元的建倉門檻，因此較審慎的做法是保留現金，等待更明確的入市時機，而非勉強做一筆信心不足的小額買入。

market_education.summary_en: Markets drifted slightly lower today with no major catalyst, as both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posted small losses in what looks like a quiet, directionless session. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off signal, institutional flows appear muted. This kind of low-volatility chop is common between earnings cycles and macro data releases.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市小幅回落，未見明顯利好或利淡消息帶動，納斯達克及標普500指數同告輕微下跌，屬於較為悶局的交易日。在缺乏強烈風險偏好或避險訊號下，機構資金流向亦顯得審慎。此類低波動整固走勢在業績期與宏觀數據公布之間頗為常見。
